about: What fails at the legacy 1.4.x code, one entry per defect: id (KD-NNN), ownerIssue, evidence (a GitHub link pinned to a full commit SHA, with a line anchor), tests (titles that carry the id; empty when the entry only lists uncaught messages), and optional uncaught (exact messages of exceptions the smoke tests tolerate). A listed test that passes, or a listed message that no longer occurs, fails the run, and the PR that fixes the defect deletes its entry. Format: e2e/harness/known-defects.js.
